sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Every day, workers at grocery stores and convenience stores in Montana carry out a sad ritual.
sentences.zh: 每天，蒙大拿州杂货店和便利店的员工都会进行一项令人悲伤的仪式。

sentences.en: First thing I do when I come on in is I go check the rotation on my milk and check my dates, of course.
sentences.zh: 我上班做的第一件事就是去检查牛奶的周转情况，当然，还要检查日期。

sentences.en: That's Ken Carson.
sentences.zh: 那是肯·卡森。

sentences.en: He's a dairy manager at a grocery store in Montana.
sentences.zh: 他是蒙大拿州一家杂货店的乳制品经理。

sentences.en: And every day when he gets in, he checks the sell-by date on his milk.
sentences.zh: 每天他一上班，就会检查牛奶的销售截止日期。

sentences.en: If it's past the date, the milk must be thrown out.
sentences.zh: 如果过了这个日期，牛奶就必须扔掉。

sentences.en: These are all 20s that I'm pulling off.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我正在撤下的20号过期的牛奶。

sentences.en: This one is dated the 18th, and I will have to pour this one down the drain.
sentences.zh: 这一盒标的是18号，我得把它倒进下水道。

sentences.en: I have probably six of them.
sentences.zh: 我大概有六盒要处理。

sentences.en: Ken is originally from Washington State, where he also worked in the grocery business.
sentences.zh: 肯来自华盛顿州，他以前也在那里从事杂货零售业。

sentences.en: When I came here four years ago, I had no idea that they were pouring down as much milk down the drain as they have been.
sentences.zh: 四年前我刚到这里时，根本没想到他们竟然倒掉了这么多牛奶。

sentences.en: In fact, it was repulsive and sickening the first couple weeks here.
sentences.zh: 事实上，刚来的头几周，这简直让人反胃和恶心。

sentences.en: It was hundreds of gallons.
sentences.zh: 那可是几百加仑啊。

sentences.en: There's nothing wrong with it.
sentences.zh: 它们明明一点问题都没有。

sentences.en: Pouring out milk happens, to some extent, in grocery stores all over the country.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地的杂货店里，倒掉牛奶的情况在一定程度上确实存在。

sentences.en: That's reporter Meredith Hoddenot.
sentences.zh: 这是记者梅雷迪思·霍德诺特。

sentences.en: But Montana throws much more of it down the drain than most places.
sentences.zh: 但蒙大拿州倒掉的牛奶比大多数地方都要多得多。

sentences.en: Because the sell-by date on the milk is required by state law to be just 12 days after pasteurization.
sentences.zh: 因为州法律规定，牛奶的销售截止日期必须在巴氏杀菌后仅12天内。

sentences.en: The industry standard is 21 days.
sentences.zh: 而行业标准是21天。

sentences.en: After these 12 days, Montana law requires that the milk be thrown away.
sentences.zh: 过了这12天，蒙大拿州法律就要求必须将牛奶扔掉。

sentences.en: It can't be sold or donated.
sentences.zh: 它们既不能出售，也不能捐赠。

sentences.en: Seems such a waste.
sentences.zh: 这看起来真是太浪费了。

sentences.en: We've got families that are in need.
sentences.zh: 我们有许多家庭正处于困境中。

sentences.en: And we're doing this.
sentences.zh: 而我们却在做这种事。

sentences.en: Montana is throwing out so much milk, in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，蒙大拿州正在扔掉大量的牛奶。

sentences.en: The price of milk there is about $2 per gallon higher than it is in surrounding states.
sentences.zh: 那里的牛奶价格比周边州每加仑高出约2美元。

sentences.en: And it's all because of this date label.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都是因为这个日期标签。

sentences.en: In theory, Montana's strict date label law is about food safety and protecting the consumer.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，蒙大拿州严格的日期标签法是为了食品安全和保护消费者。

sentences.en: But it hasn't been updated since the 80s.
sentences.zh: 但这项法律自80年代以来就再没更新过。

sentences.en: Date labels, of course, aren't just on milk.
sentences.zh: 当然，日期标签不仅仅出现在牛奶上。

sentences.en: They're on a lot of products.
sentences.zh: 很多产品上都有。

sentences.en: Use-by, sell-by, best-by, best-if-used-by.
sentences.zh: 食用期限、销售期限、最佳食用期、最佳赏味期。

sentences.en: But then some products say expires on or have an EXP, which is a shorthand for expires.
sentences.zh: 还有些产品会写“过期日期”或标注“EXP”，这是“过期”的缩写。

sentences.en: This is Emily Broadlieb, director of the Food, Law, and Policy Clinic at Harvard Law School.
sentences.zh: 这位是艾米丽·布罗德利布，哈佛法学院食品、法律与政策诊所的主任。

sentences.en: She did a tally of all the different kinds of date labeling.
sentences.zh: 她对各种日期标签进行了统计。

sentences.en: What we found was that 41 states required a date label on at least some food product.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，有41个州要求至少在某些食品上标注日期。

sentences.en: She says there are huge inconsistencies, not just in the wording, but in the meaning of these labels.
sentences.zh: 她说，这些标签不仅在措辞上，而且在含义上都存在巨大的不一致。

sentences.en: Some states require them only on dairy, some on shellfish, some on any perishable foods.
sentences.zh: 有些州只要求乳制品标注，有些要求贝类，有些则要求所有易腐食品。

sentences.en: And then 20 of those states actually restrict the sale or donation of food after the date.
sentences.zh: 而且其中20个州实际上限制了过期食品的销售或捐赠。

sentences.en: Some of them are quite strict.
sentences.zh: 有些州的规定相当严格。

sentences.en: Some of them, like, flat-out ban the sale or donation of food after the date.
sentences.zh: 有些州甚至直接禁止销售或捐赠过期食品。

sentences.en: And some of them just say, we're going to make it complicated.
sentences.zh: 还有些州只是说，我们要把事情搞复杂点。

sentences.en: The powers that be have definitely succeeded in making it complicated.
sentences.zh: 当权者确实成功地把事情搞复杂了。

sentences.en: To decipher these dates, or to know how to act on them, for large retailers and individual consumers alike.
sentences.zh: 无论是大型零售商还是普通消费者，都很难解读这些日期，或者不知道该如何处理。

sentences.en: This is a bad system, it's not making people safer, it's leading to food waste, and the dates really aren't safety-based.
sentences.zh: 这是一个糟糕的系统，它并没有让人更安全，反而导致了食物浪费，而且这些日期根本不是基于安全考虑的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The date labels on our food are not about food safety.
sentences.zh: 我们食品上的日期标签与食品安全无关。

sentences.en: And they were never actually meant to be.
sentences.zh: 而且它们本来就不是为了安全而设计的。

sentences.en: But let's back up.
sentences.zh: 但让我们回顾一下。

sentences.en: It all began in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于20世纪70年代。

sentences.en: Americans had moved farther away from their food sources.
sentences.zh: 美国人离他们的食物来源越来越远了。

sentences.en: They were eating more packaged foods and getting more of their food in supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 他们开始吃更多的包装食品，并更多地从超市获取食物。

sentences.en: And they wanted a way to measure how fresh their food was.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一种衡量食物新鲜度的方法。

sentences.en: Most manufacturers already put encrypted dates on their products to help retailers rotate stock.
sentences.zh: 大多数制造商已经在产品上标注了加密日期，以帮助零售商轮换库存。

sentences.en: And consumers craved access to this information.
sentences.zh: 而消费者渴望获得这些信息。

sentences.en: In 1977, the New York State Consumer Protection Board published a booklet called Blind Dates, How to Break the Codes on the Foods You Buy.
sentences.zh: 1977年，纽约州消费者保护委员会出版了一本名为《盲约：如何破解你所购食品的日期代码》的小册子。

sentences.en: The booklet told consumers how to decipher the encrypted date codes on their favorite products.
sentences.zh: 这本小册子告诉消费者如何解读他们喜爱的产品上加密的日期代码。

sentences.en: The board distributed more than 10,000 copies and posted the booklet in supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 委员会分发了超过1万份，并将小册子张贴在超市里。

sentences.en: Eventually, consumers started to demand that these dates be put clearly on packages.
sentences.zh: 最终，消费者开始要求在包装上清楚地标明这些日期。

sentences.en: That they shouldn't have to get a special book and decipher a code.
sentences.zh: 他们不应该非得拿着一本专门的书去破译代码。

sentences.en: And that seems pretty reasonable.
sentences.zh: 这听起来非常合理。

sentences.en: Consumers asked for date labels.
sentences.zh: 消费者要求标注日期。

sentences.en: So retailers and grocery stores responded.
sentences.zh: 于是零售商和杂货店做出了回应。

sentences.en: But at that time, everyone acknowledged this is really about quality and about freshness.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，大家都承认这实际上是关于质量和新鲜度的问题。

sentences.en: No one said, I want a label because I'm afraid it won't be safe.
sentences.zh: 没人说，我想要标签是因为我担心它不安全。

sentences.en: So a few states began to regulate these date labels.
sentences.zh: 于是，一些州开始监管这些日期标签。

sentences.en: Massachusetts was the first state that actually required date labels on food.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州是第一个真正要求在食品上标注日期标签的州。

sentences.en: But there was no federal-level regulation, even though there were a number of attempts.
sentences.zh: 但联邦层面并没有相关法规，尽管曾有过多次尝试。

sentences.en: In one Congress, I think from 1973 to 75, there were 10 bills on date labeling standardization.
sentences.zh: 在某一届国会期间，我想大概是1973到1975年，有10项关于日期标签标准化的法案。

sentences.en: None of them passed.
sentences.zh: 但没有一项获得通过。

sentences.en: Lawmakers disagreed about what the system should look like and who should oversee it.
sentences.zh: 立法者在系统应该是什么样子以及由谁来监管的问题上存在分歧。

sentences.en: The Food and Drug Administration has actually said, we could do this.
sentences.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）实际上曾表示，我们可以做这件事。

sentences.en: We have the power to do it for the foods we oversee.
sentences.zh: 我们有权对我们监管的食品进行管理。

sentences.en: But since these labels were about freshness and not about safety, ultimately, the FDA said.
sentences.zh: 但由于这些标签是关于新鲜度而非安全性的，最终，FDA表示。

sentences.en: It's not something we want to spend the time and energy on.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们想投入时间和精力去做的事情。

sentences.en: Still, consumers wanted freshness dates.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，消费者还是想要新鲜度日期。

sentences.en: So all kinds of different ones popped up.
sentences.zh: 于是各种各样的标签冒了出来。

sentences.en: Some were stamped on.
sentences.zh: 有些是盖章上去的。

sentences.en: Some printed on the label.
sentences.zh: 有些是印在标签上的。

sentences.en: There was no consistency in how this information was displayed or the language that was used.
sentences.zh: 这些信息的显示方式或所使用的语言完全没有统一性。

sentences.en: Use by.
sentences.zh: 食用期限。

sentences.en: Sell by.
sentences.zh: 销售期限。

sentences.en: Best by.
sentences.zh: 最佳食用期。

sentences.en: Best if used by.
sentences.zh: 最佳赏味期。

sentences.en: Expires on.
sentences.zh: 过期日期。

sentences.en: EXP.
sentences.zh: 过期。

sentences.en: Some companies even tried to promote these dates to sell their products.
sentences.zh: 有些公司甚至试图利用这些日期来推销他们的产品。

sentences.en: Like, hey, buy Pepsi because it's going to give you that date to tell you it's fresher than all the other soft drinks.
sentences.zh: 比如，嘿，买百事可乐吧，因为这个日期告诉你它比其他软饮料更新鲜。

sentences.en: Some things just don't need a date stamped on them to tell you how fresh they are.
sentences.zh: 有些东西根本不需要盖上日期来告诉你它有多新鲜。

sentences.en: Not so with Diet Colas.
sentences.zh: 但健怡可乐可不是这样。

sentences.en: Until now.
sentences.zh: 直到现在。

sentences.en: Now Diet Pepsi introduces freshness dating from Diet Pepsi.
sentences.zh: 现在，健怡百事推出了新鲜度日期标注。

sentences.en: Some date labels were meant for consumers, while others were just meant for retailers.
sentences.zh: 有些日期标签是给消费者看的，而另一些只是给零售商看的。

sentences.en: And as is still true now, there were no clear definitions for any of the phrases.
sentences.zh: 而且正如现在的情况一样，这些短语都没有明确的定义。

sentences.en: No consistency even within the same brand or product.
sentences.zh: 即使在同一个品牌或产品内部也没有统一性。

sentences.en: Dates could differ from state to state, manufacturer to manufacturer, or store to store.
sentences.zh: 日期可能因州而异，因制造商而异，甚至因商店而异。

sentences.en: And over the years, we've lost track of what these labels meant in the first place.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们已经忘记了这些标签最初的含义。

sentences.en: As time goes on and on, and more and more people grow up just being used to having labels on their food,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，越来越多的人从小就习惯了食品上有标签，

sentences.en: no one's ever said to them what they mean and what they don't.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人告诉过他们这些标签意味着什么，不意味着什么。

sentences.en: So, we've made some false connections.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们产生了一些错误的联系。

sentences.en: So people in their head have made this link and thought,
sentences.zh: 人们在脑海中建立了这种联系，心想，

sentences.en: well, I heard about someone getting salmonella or E.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我听说有人得了沙门氏菌或大肠杆菌，

sentences.en: coli,
sentences.zh: 而我在食物上看到了这个标签，

sentences.en: and I see this label on my food, and these two things are somehow connected to one another.
sentences.zh: 于是觉得这两者之间一定有什么联系。

sentences.en: But Emily says, as much as we might want them to,
sentences.zh: 但艾米丽说，尽管我们可能希望如此，

sentences.en: these dates are not going to tell us if our food will make us sick.
sentences.zh: 这些日期并不能告诉我们食物是否会让我们生病。

sentences.en: People keep saying, well, but I just want to know when it will be safe until...
sentences.zh: 人们总是说，好吧，但我只是想知道它在什么时候之前是安全的……

sentences.en: It's scientifically impossible to sort of say there's a date after which it will become unsafe.
sentences.zh: 从科学上讲，不可能设定一个日期，过了这个日期它就会变得不安全。

sentences.en: Milk is actually a good example of this.
sentences.zh: 牛奶就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: If you run a few errands on a hot day before getting your milk home,
sentences.zh: 如果你在炎热的天气里在把牛奶买回家之前先去办了几件事，

sentences.en: your milk will spoil faster.
sentences.zh: 你的牛奶变质得会更快。

sentences.en: And once it's in the fridge, it'll last longer at, say, 35 degrees than at 40 degrees.
sentences.zh: 一旦放进冰箱，在35度下保存的时间肯定比在40度下更长。

sentences.en: There's just too many variables.
sentences.zh: 变量实在太多了。

sentences.en: But here's the thing about spoiled milk.
sentences.zh: 但关于变质牛奶，有一点很重要。

sentences.en: Spoiled milk doesn't mean it has pathogens in it.
sentences.zh: 牛奶变质并不意味着里面有病原体。

sentences.en: That's because the harmful pathogens in milk are removed during the pasteurization process,
sentences.zh: 这是因为牛奶中的有害病原体在巴氏杀菌过程中已经被去除了，

sentences.en: along with most other bacteria.
sentences.zh: 连同大多数其他细菌一起。

sentences.en: The big misconception around date labels is that people think that old food will make them sick.
sentences.zh: 关于日期标签最大的误解是，人们认为过期的食物会让他们生病。

sentences.en: But for the most part, old food doesn't make you sick.
sentences.zh: 但大多数情况下，过期的食物并不会让你生病。

sentences.en: Contaminated food does.
sentences.zh: 被污染的食物才会。

sentences.en: The longer a carton of milk exists, the more chance it has to come into contact with contaminants
sentences.zh: 一盒牛奶存放的时间越长，它接触到污染物的机会就越多，

sentences.en: that could grow and flourish inside that milk and hurt you.
sentences.zh: 这些污染物可能会在牛奶中生长繁殖并伤害你。

sentences.en: But as long as it's properly pasteurized, there's nothing about the age specifically that makes milk dangerous to drink.
sentences.zh: 但只要它经过了适当的巴氏杀菌，牛奶本身并不会因为存放时间长而变得危险。

sentences.en: There is, however, a small handful of foods that can become unsafe with age.
sentences.zh: 不过，确实有少数几种食品会随着时间的推移变得不安全。

sentences.en: Deli meats, unpasteurized cheeses, smoked seafood, stuff in the deli section of the grocery store, basically.
sentences.zh: 熟食肉类、未经高温消毒的奶酪、烟熏海鲜，基本上就是杂货店熟食区里的那些东西。

sentences.en: These foods have a high risk for listeria, a bacteria that can be life-threatening.
sentences.zh: 这些食品感染李斯特菌的风险很高，这是一种可能危及生命的细菌。

sentences.en: And in these cases, listeria risk does increase with time.
sentences.zh: 在这些情况下，李斯特菌的风险确实会随时间增加。

sentences.en: But our current date labeling system doesn't treat this small subset of foods any differently than any other date labeled item.
sentences.zh: 但我们目前的日期标签系统并没有将这一小部分食品与其他带有日期标签的商品区别对待。

sentences.en: Most date labels are arrived at by conducting taste tests.
sentences.zh: 大多数日期标签是通过进行口味测试得出的。

sentences.en: They sit people around a table, and then they have everyone eat their product.
sentences.zh: 他们让人们围坐在一张桌子旁，然后让每个人品尝他们的产品。

sentences.en: Say it's yogurt.
sentences.zh: 假设是酸奶。

sentences.en: They taste a batch made that day.
sentences.zh: 他们品尝当天制作的一批。

sentences.en: And then they taste some from the day before, and the day before that.
sentences.zh: 然后品尝前一天制作的，再前一天制作的。

sentences.en: And they say, well, what did you think?
sentences.zh: 然后他们问，你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: Was it good?
sentences.zh: 好吃吗？

sentences.en: Was it tasty?
sentences.zh: 味道好吗？

sentences.en: Did it have the properties you expect from yogurt, or whatever the product is?
sentences.zh: 它是否具备你对酸奶或任何产品所期望的特性？

sentences.en: And when the manufacturer comes to a batch, the people say,
sentences.zh: 当制造商拿出一批产品时，人们说，

sentences.en: I don't really like the way this tastes.
sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢这个味道。

sentences.en: They say, okay, well, after that many days, our product's not going to be at its peak.
sentences.zh: 他们就会说，好吧，过了这么多天，我们的产品就不会处于最佳状态了。

sentences.en: And that's where the date really comes from.
sentences.zh: 这就是日期的真正来源。

sentences.en: So the dates on our food are arrived at through a taste teSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我们食品上的日期是通过口味测试得出的。

sentences.en: Or sometimes, especially with smaller companies, they just guess.
sentences.zh: 或者有时，特别是对于较小的公司，他们只是在猜测。

sentences.en: They've said, you know, I feel awful about it, but we don't have money to bring in and do this whole taste teSt.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道，我对此感到很糟糕，但我们没有钱请人来做这种完整的口味测试。

sentences.en: We just, you know, we look online for an estimate of what this, you know, how long this food will be fresh.
sentences.zh: 我们只是，你知道，在网上查找一下这种食物能保鲜多久的估计值。

sentences.en: Or we just kind of say, like, well, you know, I only keep it in my refrigerator for three days, so I'll put three days on it.
sentences.zh: 或者我们只是说，嗯，你知道，我只在冰箱里放三天，所以我就标上三天。

sentences.en: Some of them are very unscientific about where that date actually comes from.
sentences.zh: 其中一些关于日期来源的说法非常不科学。

sentences.en: And yet today, according to a report that Emily Broadlieb co-authored,
sentences.zh: 然而今天，根据艾米丽·布罗德利布参与撰写的一份报告，

sentences.en: a majority of consumers believe that eating food past its sell-by or use-by date is a risk to their health.
sentences.zh: 大多数消费者认为，食用超过“销售截止日期”或“最佳食用日期”的食品会危害健康。

sentences.en: And as many as 90% of Americans throw out food based on date labels, at least occasionally.
sentences.zh: 多达90%的美国人至少偶尔会根据日期标签扔掉食物。

sentences.en: We're throwing out billions of pounds of food here in America simply because of misunderstanding of those code dates.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国扔掉了数十亿磅的食物，仅仅是因为对这些日期代码的误解。

sentences.en: This is Doug Rau, former president of Trader Joe's.
sentences.zh: 这位是道格·劳（Doug Rau），Trader Joe's的前总裁。

sentences.en: He's been in the grocery business for more than 40 years.
sentences.zh: 他在杂货行业工作了40多年。

sentences.en: In 2015, he founded Daily Table, a non-profit retail store that sells pre-made meals sourced from food that would otherwise be wasted.
sentences.zh: 2015年，他创立了Daily Table，这是一家非营利性零售店，专门销售由本会被浪费的食物制成的预制餐。

sentences.en: We waste a staggering amount of food.
sentences.zh: 我们浪费的食物数量惊人。

sentences.en: The average American wastes somewhere between 20 and 25% of the food they acquire.
sentences.zh: 普通美国人会浪费掉他们所获取食物的20%到25%。

sentences.en: And it's not just wasting the food.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是浪费食物本身。

sentences.en: It's wasting the water to grow it, the transportation to get it to the supermarket,
sentences.zh: 这还浪费了种植食物所需的水，以及将其运送到超市的运输成本，

sentences.en: everything that goes into getting food to your plate.
sentences.zh: 以及将食物送到你餐桌上所投入的一切。

sentences.en: Doug and Emily both say that to make date labels serve us better and to waste less food,
sentences.zh: 道格和艾米丽都认为，为了让日期标签更好地为我们服务并减少食物浪费，

sentences.en: we need to consider the language we're using.
sentences.zh: 我们需要考虑我们所使用的语言。

sentences.en: Sell-by, use-by, enjoy-by.
sentences.zh: “销售截止日期”、“食用截止日期”、“最佳赏味期限”。

sentences.en: Like, what does that mean, you know?
sentences.zh: 比如，这些到底是什么意思，你懂的？

sentences.en: And the idea of an expiration date is problematic, too.
sentences.zh: 而且“过期日期”这个概念也有问题。

sentences.en: If something's expired, it's dead.
sentences.zh: 如果某样东西过期了，它就“死”了。

sentences.en: If your credit card's expired, it's dead.
sentences.zh: 如果你的信用卡过期了，它就“死”了。

sentences.en: You can't use it.
sentences.zh: 你就不能用了。

sentences.en: Heaven forbid your dog expired, you know, there's no more life.
sentences.zh: 天哪，要是你的狗过期了，那可就没命了，你懂的。

sentences.en: Well, no one's interested in expired food.
sentences.zh: 好吧，没人会对过期的食物感兴趣。

sentences.en: No one's interested in eating dead food.
sentences.zh: 没人想吃死掉的食物。

sentences.en: I actually prefer most of my food dead.
sentences.zh: 其实我更喜欢我大部分的食物是“死”的。

sentences.en: But the point is this.
sentences.zh: 但重点是这个。

sentences.en: When food is perceived as inedible, you can't do anything with it.
sentences.zh: 当食物被认为不可食用时，你就拿它没办法了。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to eat it, and you can't give it to a food pantry.
sentences.zh: 没人想吃它，你也不能把它捐给食物救济站。

sentences.en: And a lot of states have laws that actually forbid the donation of so-called expired food.
sentences.zh: 而且许多州都有法律明令禁止捐赠所谓的过期食品。

sentences.en: Emily suggests only using the term expired for foods that actually do become unsafe with time.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽建议只对那些随着时间推移确实会变得不安全的食品使用“过期”一词。

sentences.en: Those unpasteurized cheeses and deli meats.
sentences.zh: 比如那些未经高温消毒的奶酪和熟食肉类。

sentences.en: For everything else, she would go with best if used by.
sentences.zh: 对于其他所有食品，她建议使用“最佳食用日期”。

sentences.en: So there would be two labels, expires on and best if used by.
sentences.zh: 所以会有两个标签：“过期日期”和“最佳食用日期”。

sentences.en: And this would be a standardized system used all across the country.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个在全国范围内使用的标准化系统。

sentences.en: Creating standardized, easy-to-understand date labels is a design problem that must have a design solution.
sentences.zh: 创建标准化、易于理解的日期标签是一个设计问题，必须有一个设计解决方案。

sentences.en: Maybe Emily suggested labels, or maybe something else entirely.
sentences.zh: 也许是艾米丽建议的标签，又或者是其他完全不同的东西。

sentences.en: The fix doesn't seem like it should be that hard.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的解决看起来不应该那么难。

sentences.en: And yet.
sentences.zh: 然而。

sentences.en: Most of the time when we say, this is an issue, it needs to change.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，当我们说“这是一个问题，需要改变”时，

sentences.en: People say, I agree, it's a terrible issue.
sentences.zh: 人们会说：“我同意，这是一个严重的问题。”

sentences.en: But then people really get stuck up on, well, which phrase should we use?
sentences.zh: 但随后人们真的会纠结于：“好吧，我们应该用哪个短语呢？”

sentences.en: And how do we decide which foods have which one?
sentences.zh: “我们该如何决定哪些食物用哪个标签？”

sentences.en: These are the very same questions that tied up regulation the first time around in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 这些正是20世纪70年代第一次监管时就困扰人们的问题。

sentences.en: But the stakes are different this time, because food waste is now a part of a national conversation.
sentences.zh: 但这次情况不同了，因为食物浪费现在已成为全国性话题的一部分。

sentences.en: The EPA and USDA announced a goal to cut food waste in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国环保署（EPA）和美国农业部（USDA）宣布了一个目标，即到2030年将美国的食物浪费减少一半。

sentences.en: in half by 2030.
sentences.zh: 而拥有一个更好的日期标签系统是实现这一目标的方法之一。

sentences.en: And having a better date labeling system is one way to get there.
sentences.zh: 但目前，艾米丽很乐意帮助解决你们更微观的争论。

sentences.en: But for now, Emily is happy to help settle your more micro-level disputes.
sentences.zh: 基本上，答案是相信你的味觉，而不是日期。

sentences.en: Basically, the answer is trust your taste, not the date.
sentences.zh: 我从朋友、家人、同事那里听到最多的故事，而且我现在还在听到，

sentences.en: So the story that I heard most from friends, from family, from colleagues, and I continue
sentences.zh: 就是有人会说：“我很高兴你发布了这份报告，

sentences.en: to hear now is that, you know, there's someone says, I'm so glad you put this report out
sentences.zh: 因为我多年来一直告诉我的妻子，日期并不重要。

sentences.en: because I've been telling my wife for years that the dates don't matter.
sentences.zh: 现在我终于证明我是对的了”，或者反之亦然。

sentences.en: And now I'm really vindicated or, you know, vice versa.
sentences.zh: 所以，与其为日期标签争论不休，不如参与到夫妻在冰箱前进行的另一种仪式中去，

sentences.en: So instead of arguing over date labels, you should take part in that other ritual that happens
sentences.zh: 当你打开一盒看起来不太对劲的东西，

sentences.en: between spouses in front of the refrigerator, where you open up a dodgy carton of something
sentences.zh: 然后问对方：“你闻着这东西还好吗？”

sentences.en: or other and ask, does this smell okay to you?
